proof.text: Identify the restricted pushforward of the closed structure sheaf with the associated affine quotient and sheafify its chosen projective resolution.

Extend the resolution into nonpositive cochain degrees. Projective terms sheafify to flat terms; use bounded-above flat K-flatness and the affine derived tensor formula to compute the ambient tensor. Exact tilde and isoLeftDerivedObj identify its homology with the associated self-Tor module.

For each supplied augmented a and pure-tensor comparison k, sheafify the augmentation square and invert its quasi-isomorphisms. Naturality of the derived tensor comparison, exact restriction-of-scalars homology, and the tilde unit gives the stated equation for q. This is the naturality part of the same ambient comparison, and involves no tensor pullback to Z.
